headline: Public hearing on R-26-077, a $146,617.94 supplemental appropriation of unanticipated revenue to the Opioid Abatement Expendable Trust Fund.
summary: The item would add $146,617.94 in FY2027 unanticipated revenue to Fund #7024. The agenda includes a time for public testimony.
items: Public hearing on R-26-077: supplemental appropriation of $146,617.94 of FY2027 unanticipated revenue into Fund #7024, Opioid Abatement Expendable Trust Fund
